name: spinalcordtoolbox-deepseg
label: Spinal Cord Toolbox
description: Runs Neurodesk Spinal Cord Toolbox sct_deepseg on the first NIfTI file in a scan-level NIFTI resource and stores the derived segmentation on the scan.
command-line: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; input="$(find -L /input -type f \( -iname "*.nii" -o -iname "*.nii.gz" \) | sort | head -n 1)"; if [ -z "$input" ]; then echo "No NIfTI file found in /input" >&2; exit 2; fi; case "$SCT_DEEPSEG_TASK" in spinalcord|sc_epi|sc_lumbar_t2|sc_mouse_t1|graymatter|gm_sc_7t_t2star|gm_wm_exvivo_t2|gm_mouse_t1|gm_wm_mouse_t1|lesion_ms|lesion_ms_axial_t2|lesion_ms_mp2rage|lesion_sci_t2|tumor_t2|rootlets|sc_canal_t2|spine) ;; *) echo "Invalid SCT deepseg task: $SCT_DEEPSEG_TASK" >&2; exit 2;; esac; qc_args=(); case "$SCT_WRITE_QC" in true) qc_args=(-qc /output/qc);; false) ;; *) echo "Invalid SCT QC flag: $SCT_WRITE_QC" >&2; exit 2;; esac; sct_deepseg "$SCT_DEEPSEG_TASK" -i "$input" -o "/output/sct_${SCT_DEEPSEG_TASK}_seg.nii.gz" "${qc_args[@]}"'

inputs.name: sct-task
inputs.label: SCT task
inputs.description: sct_deepseg task. Supported values include spinalcord, graymatter, lesion_ms, rootlets, sc_canal_t2, and spine.

inputs.name: write-qc
inputs.label: Write QC
inputs.description: Write SCT QC report files into the output resource.

xnat.name: spinalcordtoolbox-deepseg-scan
xnat.label: Spinal Cord Toolbox
xnat.description: Run Neurodesk Spinal Cord Toolbox sct_deepseg on this scan's NIFTI resource

external-inputs.name: scan
external-inputs.description: Input scan with a NIFTI resource.
